neighbours.label: unclear; best guess: ' begun' in 'had begun to <wane>'
fire: Long after the shouting had begun to subside, she stayed awake.
Once the snow had begun to melt, the roads reopened.
After the music had begun to fade, the dancers sat down.
By the time the fever had begun to drop, the doctor left.
Even when the wind had begun to weaken, the boats stayed in port.
When the storm had begun to pass, the birds returned.
Only after the crowd had begun to disperse did the police leave.
Late at night, after the rain had begun to slacken, he went out.
quiet: Long after the shouting was over, she stayed awake.
Once the snow was gone, the roads reopened.
After the music ended, the dancers sat down.
By the time the fever was gone, the doctor left.
Even when the wind was calm, the boats stayed in port.
When the storm was over, the birds returned.
Only after the crowd went home did the police leave.
Late at night, after the rain stopped, he went out.

notes: Top examples heterogeneous (begun x3, rejected, launcher, of, on). Probe inconsistent: 'had begun to ease' 0.33 but 'had begun to fade' 0.03.
